modules.alt: The logo of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
The logo celebrating the 40th anniversary of The Legend of Zelda games.

modules.heading: A classic tale, built from the ground up for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system.

assets.alt: The trailer for the Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time sits inside a rectangle modal, overtop a background of gently glowly fireflies.
assets.caption: Gameplay of the trailer for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time begins as glowing fireflies hover gently across the screen.

modules.alt: An adult link riding across the fields of Hyrule on the back of his horse, Epona.
modules.caption: Gameplay of the Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time featuring a young Link exploring the Kokiri forest, battling enemies and riding across Hyrule as adult link on the back of his horse, Epona.

modules.heading: Gameplay of the Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time featuring a young Link exploring the Kokiri forest, battling enemies and riding across Hyrule as adult link on the back of his horse, Epona.
Take up your sword and embark on a grand adventure!

content.value: The evil Ganondorf is scheming to steal the mythical Triforce from the Sacred Realm and take over the world. Now Link must become the Hero of Time and save the kingdom in the
Legend of Zelda™: Ocarina of Time
game, exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.

asset.alt: A Fairy glowing brightly

content.value: Link is the only member of the Kokiri who doesn't have a fairy, until the Great Deku Tree asks Navi to accompany him in his adventures.
Fairies often have helpful hints to share—if you see any on this page, be sure to see what they have to say!

modules.alt: A tapestry showing the Great Deku tree surrounded by imagery of a sleeping Link, Saria, Ganondorf and Zelda.

asset.alt: A young Link sitting on a tree stump, holding his head in his hand as he reaches out towards his fairy, Navi.

content.value: The young hero of the story, accompanied by his trusty fairy, Navi.

asset.alt: A young Princess Zelda sits on a stone and holds the Ocarina of Time.

content.value: The young princess of Hyrule seeking to protect her kingdom.

asset.alt: Ganondorf striding forward with an outstretched hand conjuring a wicked magic.

content.value: The menacing leader of the Gerudo, who harbors ambitions to seize the Triforce.

modules.heading: The legend reborn for a new generation

content.value: Enjoy completely overhauled visuals, orchestral music, voice acting, and expanded cutscenes. Jump and dash through the action with enhanced controls and modern camera movements, making this a great entry point into this legendary series.

modules.alt: The Hylian Shield and Master Sword sitting over a background of gently glowing firelies. To its left floats a glowing fairy pulsing up and down.

modules.heading: Learn a little more about the story and local lore with these new features!

asset.alt: A Goron looking towards a young Link as they share gossip about bomb flowers.

content.value: Listen to
new and expanded dialog
from characters big and small.

asset.alt: The fairy, Navi, and young Link stumbling upon a fairy sentiment and learning more about Fairy lore.

content.value: If you’re more interested in the magical side of Hyrule, look for small, sparkling symbols throughout the land that unlock fascinating bits of
fairy lore

asset.alt: Of the Hall of Fallen Foes where players can discover more about enemies they've defeated.

content.value: You can also visit the
Hall of Fallen Foes
to find out more about enemies you’ve defeated.

asset.alt: An in-progress tapestry showing the progress a player has made in the game.

content.value: Track your progress—and next objectives—with the
Threads of Time
, where you can also view a grand tapestry that tells the tale of your adventure, step by step as you play.

modules.alt: An adult Link wielding the Master Sword as he steadies himself for battle.

modules.heading: A series of gameplay moments scrolls across the screen from right to left.

content.value: During his epic journey to save the kingdom, our young hero becomes much more powerful—and so does his equipment!

assets.alt: Young Link bracing himself to pull up the Master Sword.
assets.caption: Gameplay of a young Link using his strength to pull up the Master Sword before transforming into adult Link.

modules.alt: A young Link standing in 3/4 profile as he looks upwards and out towards the viewer.
An adult Link standing to Young Link's right, holding the Master Sword and gazing toward the viewer with a look of determination.

content.value: He may be small, but young Link’s kid-sized weapons help him take on foes twice his size.
As Link grows older, he gains the ability to wield the legendary Master Sword, along with other useful tools to help him on his quest.

modules.heading: Help Link become the Hero of Time

asset.alt: The Kokiri Sword a Young Link finds in the Koriki Forest.

content.value: This small, child-sized sword is a treasure of Kokiri Forest.

asset.alt: The wooden Deku Shield Young Link uses in the game.

content.value: Made of lightweight wood, this shield is the perfect size for a child to use, but it will burn up if it gets lit on fire.

asset.alt: A wooden, but very strong, Fairy Slingshot that a Young Link will use.

content.value: The stretchy sling on this child-sized toy is perfect for launching Deku seeds at distant targets.

asset.alt: A branch from the Deku Tree that Young Link can use to set ablaze or attack a foe.

content.value: This kind of branch can be set ablaze or used to give your foes a painful whack.

asset.alt: The Master Sword that Adult Link is strong enough to wield.

content.value: Wielded only by the Hero of Time, the Blade of Evil’s Bane has the power to transcend time in order to smite evil.

asset.alt: The Hylian Shield bestowed upon an Adult Link.

content.value: A mainstay for adult Hylian soldiers, this shield is sturdy and fireproof, but it was heavy for young Link and required all his strength to hold. Now that Link is grown, however, he can easily wield it with one hand while holding his sword in the other.

asset.alt: The Fairy Bow Adult Link uses in place of his Fairy Slingshot.

content.value: You can use this weapon to attack distant targets, but it takes adult strength to draw and fire arrows.

asset.alt: The Hookshot an Adult Link uses in the game.

content.value: This contraption lets the user latch on and zip to distant targets.

asset.alt: Link standing in front of a wall aiming towards an object with one of his ranged weapons.

content.value: Ranged weapons like the Fairy Bow and the Hookshot can be aimed through button controls or through motion controls. You can customize that in the Options menu.
Whether you’re a first-time visitor or a seasoned adventurer, you’ll want to explore every corner of this fabled land—you never know who you might meet!

asset.alt: Lon Lon Ranch and its' famed cows.

content.value: The cows at this farm are famous for their rejuvenating milk, but the ranch’s prized horses are the real reason to visit.

asset.alt: Hyrule Castle on a bright and sunny day.

content.value: This majestic palace is home to the royal family, including Princess Zelda. The castle is only accessible by official invitation (unless you can find another way in). Just south of the stronghold lies Hyrule Castle Town, a lively village full of shops and friendly locals.

asset.alt: Korkiri Forest flooded with sunlight and home to the Great Deku Tree.

content.value: The green and woodsy home of Link and the peaceful Kokiri, childlike folk who never grow old, along with their trusty fairies. They live in the shade of the Great Deku Tree, their wise and ancient guardian.

asset.alt: The beautiful waterfall filled Zora Domain.

content.value: Follow Zora River to the waterfall and play a specific tune on your ocarina to gain entrance to the enchanting land of the Zora—the proud, fishlike folk who rule the waters of Hyrule.

asset.alt: A heat-filled Goron City with red rock and hard-working Gorons.

content.value: Just up the hill from Kakariko Village (right below fiery Death Mountain) is Goron City, home of the hard-working, rock-eating Gorons.

asset.alt: The small town of Kakirko Village featuring a ginat windmill.

content.value: On the way to the Death Mountain Trail lies the small town of Kakariko Village, home to many colorful characters.

modules.heading: A illustrated map of Hyrule animates on to the screen showing the Zora Domain, Goron City, Kakariko Village and more.

assets.alt: A Young Link playing Zelda's Lullaby on his Ocarina as a pink glow emanates from him.
assets.caption: Young Link playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Ocarina. His song reveals something hidden beyond a waterfall.

assets.alt: Adult Link playing the Song of Time on the legendary Ocarina of Time as a blue glow emanates from him.
assets.caption: Adult Link playing the Song of Time on the legendary Ocarina of Time as a blue glow emanates from him and reveals a hidden doorway.

content.value: You can play Link’s
Fairy Ocarina
or the
Ocarina of Time
with traditional button controls or try humming, or even playing your own instruments into the Nintendo Switch 2 microphone!

assets.alt: Young Link playing the Ocarina of Time as inputted by the player's voice.
assets.caption: A player humming into the microphone as Young Link begins to play Zelda's Lullaby on the Ocarina of Time.

asset.alt: A Young Link plays the Sun Song on the Ocarina of Time as Navi floats alongside him.

content.value: The songs Link learns to play on his ocarina have all kinds of effects, like opening new paths, changing day to night, and more.
Link’s ocarina may appear to be an ordinary musical instrument, but if played correctly, can wield incredible magical powers.

modules.alt: The legendary blue Ocarina of Time gently glimmering from left to right.
Young Link closing his eyes as he begins to play the Ocarina of Time.

modules.heading: Unlock the power of the ocarina

content.value: With
ZELDA NOTES

, part of the free Nintendo Switch App* for smart phones and tablets, you can challenge yourself to find specific in-game locations with Gossip Quests, or test your game knowledge with the Ocarina of Time Quiz, featuring over 2,000 questions. You can also view Today’s Record or use Play Ocarina to make music on the go!

modules.alt: A mobile phone showing the Zelda Notes App.

modules.heading: Expand your adventure with ZELDA NOTES

content.value: Explore Hyrule in style with this special edition Nintendo Switch 2 system.

Ambiios of a Young Zelda sitting on a rock holding the legendary Ocarina of Time and a Young Link sitting on a tree stump holding Navi.

Product:{\"sku\":\"7100130792\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Take up your sword and embark on a grand adventure! The evil Ganondorf is determined to steal his way into the legendary Sacred Realm, seize the mythical Triforce, and conquer the world. It’s up to you, as the young hero Link, to stop him.

Set out with your companion fairy, Navi, on a quest to venture into deadly dungeons, solve puzzles, and collect weapons of great power. You’ll need to travel across time in two different eras to restore balance to Hyrule!

A classic tale, built from the ground up for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system

This version of the story that first debuted on the Nintendo 64™ system features completely overhauled visuals, characters with voiced dialogue (and a great deal more to say), expanded cutscenes, symphonic orchestral music, reworked camera and movement controls, and more. You can even play Link’s in-game ocarina by humming or playing your own instrument using the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system microphone.

This classic tale, reborn on Nintendo Switch 2, is an excellent entry point into the Legend of Zelda™ series!

Get a digital wallpaper as an early purchase bonus!

Purchase the digital version of the game before Nov. 23, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. PT and you can get a Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary digital wallpaper as an early purchase bonus. The wallpaper is available in several formats for different screen types, and you can download it through the My Nintendo link that will be sent to the email associated with your Nintendo Account after the promotion period ends.



Get more out of your adventure with ZELDA NOTES on the Nintendo Switch App

Get a little extra support on your quest with ZELDA NOTES—a game-specific service found in the Nintendo Switch App* on compatible smart devices. See your accomplishments for the day, take on the challenge of finding in-game locations based on images, and even play an ocarina on your smart device!

Tap any existing Legend of Zelda series amiibo for in-game extras

Get in-game extras to help you on your adventure by tapping any Legend of Zelda series amiibo™ figure**. If you tap the new Young Link and Young Zelda amiibo figures (coming in 2027), you’ll get in-game masks that evoke a retro graphical style!
